## Checklist

- [ ] Branch name and commits follow the convention (`feat/…`, `fix: …`) — see `CONTRIBUTING.md`
- [ ] `npm run check` passes locally (format, lint, typecheck, tests with coverage)
- [ ] New logic has unit tests; user-facing flows have integration or e2e coverage
- [ ] Errors are handled and logged; no `console.*`, no swallowed errors
- [ ] Inputs are validated; no secrets, API keys, or personal data in code, logs, or screenshots
- [ ] Accessibility: touch targets ≥ 56px, text readable at "Extra large", screen-reader labels present
- [ ] Both languages (ID/EN) updated for any new UI text
- [ ] Docs updated (README / docs/API.md / docs/ARCHITECTURE.md) if behaviour or contracts changed
